text_block_list.text:
After joint training in VR space,
Godolphin Barb spoke to horse girl
who had just transferred to academy.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Good work.
How are you feeling, desu wa?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: G-Goddess...

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Your times don't seem to improve much.
Any troubles with training?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for asking...
But I'm okay.
Just my own lack of effort...

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
...No need to put on brave face, desu wa.
Living in unfamiliar place is difficult.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Ah! How did you know I was struggling
with my new life...?

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
I know.
Your suffering is my suffering.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
You try hard enough.
However... homesick, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
—Let me see.
How about this, desu wa?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: ...Ah?! This is... my hometown...!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Changed space settings.
Thought here you could relax completely.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
How about training here until you adjust
to academy? Or would you prefer
change of pace first, desu wa?

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, let us ask trainer's opinion.
Trainer over there, what do you think?
choice_data_list: Change of pace needed first, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: Yes, let us do that, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Ah...!
Scenery I used to run past... so nostalgic...
Here, feel like I can do best!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, little help like this,
ask anytime, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
To me, you horse girls
are just like beloved children.

Eyes of Godolphin Barb speaking like that
resembled mother watching child grow.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: Yes, that sounds lovely, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Tell me, anything in mind?
Glad to join you, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Um... Back home, used to play in nearby
river with friends, but...
Is that really okay?

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Whatever brings you joy,
I wish to do, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you got me, desu wa.
Now in return—take this!

Godolphin Barb plays in stream with transfer student.
Impressed by deep heart treating everyone without discrimination.
